mapper.sql: mt.id, mt.physical_name, mt.logical_name, mt.description, mt.created_at, mt.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM meta_table mt WHERE mt.id = #{id}

where.if: AND (mt.physical_name LIKE #{keywordUpper} ESCAPE '!' OR mt.logical_name LIKE #{keyword} ESCAPE '!')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO meta_table (physical_name, logical_name, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{physicalName}, #{logicalName}, #{description}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
